wrapperWhitelistNote: Five reviewed entries, all agent attestation (no human has reviewed them). One is the architecture page's scroll-typewriter hero (a pinned stage plus scroll runway, still warns). Four are the dominant uniform lists of short pages (/blog, /changelog/2026, /help/academy, /help/reference/...): those pages have fewer than three in-flow sections so the share rule skips them, and the entries record that decision explicitly instead of leaving it implicit. Everything else passes after semantic decomposition.

cloneParity.kind: geometry parity (section wrapper box heights, live vs clone, same viewport), from the pixel-audit dumps; homepage only
cloneParity.pixelParity: NOT MEASURED: no live-site screenshots were captured for a pixel comparison, so no pixel-parity number is claimed

platform.kind: per-section pixel parity, live (attio.com) vs clone, /platform/* routes
platform.method: Each <main> block is reached by scrolling (scroll-through first, then scrollTo(block top)), fonts and images awaited, captured in 900px tiles at the same scroll offsets in both builds. Masked in both: the site header (shell), fixed overlays (cookie/chat), <canvas> and <video>. Primary metric: ink block-map Dice (|px-bg|>30 ink mask, 12px box blur, 4x downsample) over every tile of the live block height, so a shorter clone block is penalised. Secondary: raw pixel match (4x downsample, tol 25/255, background included).
platform.calibration: first tile per section on the five legacy routes: blank clone 0, clone shifted 150px down mean 9 / max 35, a different section mean 19 / max 66.
platform.gateResult: NOT MET for every section: 37 of 98 sections are below 80%. Each is listed under exceptions as pending human approval; none has been approved.
platform.responsiveDocHeights: 768 and 390 document heights within -5.3%..+2.6% of live on all 12 routes; no horizontal overflow on either build (recorded by the harness, not gated).
